description: The Pacific Northwest (PNW) is a geographic region in the northwestern USA, reaching from the Rocky Mountains west to the Pacific Ocean. The region is famous for its beautiful coastline, green scenery, and spectacular mountain ranges, with some of the nation’s most impressive national parks.
